adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous `console.error(...)` block that logged `tokenResponse.error` and the raw `responseJson` was removed when switching from `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. However, this does not make failures “silently absorbed”: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when parsing fails. The real issue is reduced diagnosability/observability because the thrown error is generic and the MS response/Zod error details are no longer logged here.
